name: Q 版黏土
description: 紧凑圆润的简化比例配合哑光黏土压痕，呈现柔软亲切的可爱手塑感。
rendering_prompt: Simplify the subject into compact, plump, soft, rounded volumes, using short, thick structural proportions for a lighthearted, adorable form. Keep a hand-molded clay surface with a matte finish, tiny pressure marks, and gentle seams. Express key identifying features through a few clear shapes. Use clean, welcoming colors, soft light, and warm delicate contact shadows. Avoid glossy plastic or fluffy fiber materials.
avoid: 写实比例、光亮塑料、毛绒材料
difference: Q 版黏土强调短粗比例；普通黏土定格可保持自然比例
tuning: 先选出最关键的两三处识别特征，再压缩非关键结构。
